title: cad-drawings command summary
description: Short JSON printed on stdout by every scripts/cad.py command and by scripts/doctor.py. Keep it under ~4 KB: large data goes to files in run_dir and is referenced from outputs.

status.description: ok = exit 0; partial = exit 7; refused = the command declined on purpose (missing backend, unsafe target); error = anything else.

exit_code.description: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 bad arguments, 3 missing dependency or backend, 4 resource busy (lock, document open elsewhere), 5 timeout, 6 edit precondition not met, 7 partial success.

backend.description: Backend that did the work: com, ezdxf, oda, libredwg, pypdfium2, pymupdf, none.

approximate.description: True when the result comes from a fallback that is not faithful to the CAD application (e.g. ezdxf drawing instead of a native plot, LibreDWG conversion).

summary.description: A few command-specific numbers or flags the agent needs immediately (counts, page sizes, found/changed totals). No lists longer than ~20 items.

outputs.description: Named artifacts written by the command.

source_mtime.description: mtime of the source this artifact was produced from. Every artifact must be newer than or equal to it.

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. NO_BACKEND, DOC_OPEN_BY_USER, COM_TRANSIENT, PRECONDITION_FAILED, DISK_LOW, TIMEOUT.

hint.description: What the agent or user can do next.

run_dir.description: Fresh per-run directory holding outputs, status.json, progress.log.

log.description: Full log file with details that did not fit here.
